messages:
elaine_csm: Kicking off LatticeIQ onboarding. Goals: integrate Redwood API into their staging, complete security review, and a pilot load test in 14 days. Quick check on owners and risks?

jun_product: Stakeholders: CEO = Mira, Eng lead = Kunal, Security = Nora. They want daily check-ins first week.

kai_eng: Perf note: for p50~200ms we can use redwood-small; p95 depends on batch sizes. Will share perf matrix today.

nora_sec: Security asks: SOC2 checklist, data retention policy, and EU-only processing for some datasets. Need legal looped for DPA.

elaine_csm: Success criteria: 1) staging calls authenticated and passing smoke tests, 2) security signoff, 3) their engineers can run sample prompts unaided.

onboard-bot: ACTION CREATED: #1410 - "LatticeIQ security DPA" assigned to nora_sec, due 2024-11-06.

jun_product: Enablement plan: API walkthrough Day 2, ops/cost controls Day 6, runbook workshop Day 11. I'll schedule.

elaine_csm: Feedback capture: create a short form + #latticeiq-feedback channel. Daily 3-question pulse first 5 days.

kai_eng: Sharing quick curl example for staging: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-small\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'

elaine_csm: Actions: kai -> perf matrix; nora -> DPA draft; jun -> calendar + runbook. I'll loop sales for billing/reserved capacity risk. Standup tomorrow 10:00 PT.
